name: Conversational BI & Variance Analyst
description: Guards SQL generation against missing partition filters and join fanout explosions, computes exact Volume-Mix-Rate KPI bridges with z-score anomaly detection, and profiles datasets in RAM to emit verified A2UI chart payloads.

Profiles tabular datasets in RAM for completeness, null rates, quantiles, outliers, truncation ceilings, and A2UI Canvas payloads.
